svg.title: LionDriver V-cycle
svg.desc: Time axis: Governance phase, G0 Mar 2027–May 2027; Concept phase, G1 Nov 2027–May 2028; System design phase, G2 Jul 2028–May 2029; HW/SW development phase, G3 Nov 2029–May 2031; Integration and verification phase, G4 Sep 2030–Sep 2032; Validation and release phase, G5 Jul 2031–Mar 2034; Operation phase, G6 continuous. Now in the Governance phase. Concept and hazards (G1): WP-C-01…12; 12 draft. Opens its exploded view. Vehicle validation (G1–G5): WP-V-01…07; 7 draft. Opens its exploded view. System requirements (G2): WP-S-01, -02, -06, -07; 4 draft. Opens its exploded view. System verification (G4): WP-S-09; 1 draft. Opens its exploded view. System architecture (G2): WP-S-03…05, WP-A-01…05; 8 draft. Opens its exploded view. System integration (G4): WP-S-08; 1 draft. Opens its exploded view. Hardware and software requirements (G3): WP-H-01, WP-W-02; 2 draft. Opens its exploded view. Hardware and software integration (G3–G4): WP-W-07, -08, WP-H-06, -07; 4 draft. Opens its exploded view. Detailed design (G3): WP-W-03, -04, WP-H-02…05; 6 draft. Opens its exploded view. Unit verification (G3): WP-W-06; 1 draft. Opens its exploded view. Implementation (G3): WP-W-01, -05, -09, -10, -11; 5 draft. Opens its exploded view. Management plans (G0–G4): WP-M-00…14; 15 draft. Opens its exploded view. Supporting processes (G0–G5): WP-P-01…11; 11 draft. Opens its exploded view. Traceability (G1–G5): WP-T-01; 1 draft. Opens its exploded view. Safety case (G1–G5): WP-K-01…06; 4 skeleton · 2 draft. Opens its exploded view. Operation and field (G1–G6): WP-O-01…05; 5 draft. Opens its exploded view. Legend: status colours, the next-gate outline and the verifies line.

g.text: Where each work product sits on the V, which gate needs it, and how far it has matured. Generated from the work-product register (WP-M-00) and the schedule (WP-M-03).
Filled diamond = gate passed in a recorded review · no gate passed yet
Item definition, HARA, FSC, SOTIF, TARA, AI safety
Safety, SOTIF and cyber validation, fault injection
Functional, safety, cyber and production requirements
TSC, timing, HSI and the system safety analyses
Integration and test of the item
SW integration, embedded SW on HIL, HW verification
SW architecture, HW design and their safety analyses
Static analysis, unit tests, MISRA, coverage
panda safety firmware, openpilot and opendbc code, calibration data, ML model
Status of each work product (one block each):
Outline: due at the next gate, G0
Dashed line: the right-hand box verifies the left-hand box
Each box opens its exploded view
Work products are grouped by hand; their status, gates and dates are read from the records on every build, so the V moves as they change. Status is not acceptance.

Terms: AI artificial intelligence · FSC functional safety concept · G0–G6 gate G0…G6 of the project lifecycle · HARA hazard analysis and risk assessment (ISO 26262-3) · HIL hardware in the loop: the bench with the real panda and

simulated car buses · HSI hardware-software interface · HW hardware · MISRA MISRA C, the coding guideline for the C of the envelope (WP-W-01 §5) · ML machine learning · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448):

hazards with nothing failing · SW software · TARA threat analysis and risk assessment (ISO/SAE 21434) · TSC technical safety concept · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H
hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
